source_documents.file_name: Standard bank SaveUp account & stash tax free.pdf

about: Stash is a tax-free investment app that helps clients invest small amounts of money every day via the Stash app, backed and operated by Liberty Group Limited. Clients can invest into an SA Top 40 Shares portfolio, a Cash+ portfolio, or both.

key_features.description: Stash automatically from a connected bank card from as little as R5 per day, or stash at any time with a press of a button.
Choose to invest in an SA Top 40 Shares portfolio, a Cash+ portfolio, or both, depending on needs and investment goals.
Use the app to pause, adjust, stop and restart how and when you invest.
Cash out anytime directly from the app, deposited into a connected bank card.
A Stash tax-free investment can be opened for children, in the child's own name, using their own annual and lifetime tax-free limits (limited contribution features apply).

Includes 'Stash as you sweat' (5c per 20 calories/100m walked/100 steps via fitness app integration), 'Stash when it's sunny' (stashes money on sunny days), 'Stash in a tap' (manual top-ups), 'Boost your Stash' (up to R1000 pm at month-end), the '10c Challenge' (increase daily contribution by 10c per day for a year, targeting R679.50 by year end), and 'Stash with GameDay' (invest based on sporting team performance with a per-match limit).

cash_plus.description: Grows money a little every day.

sa_top_40_shares.description: Performance of SA's biggest listed companies, including dividends paid to investors.

fees.loyalty_bonus: Fee earned back as a loyalty bonus after 12 months if funds are not withdrawn within the next 12 months (effective from 1 March 2025).

eligibility.general: Available via the Stash app to individual investors.
eligibility.children: A Stash tax-free investment can be opened for children, in the child's own name, subject to limited contribution features. Child must turn 18 to access certain benefits.

protection_measures: Secured PIN and fingerprint authentication (where phone allows).
